rationale: The design already names schema/static/unit/transactional boundaries. Named-tier proof plus authentic guided/replay wiring removes blanket Cartesian promotion while preserving explicitly joined authority, effect, audit, privacy, revocation and real-process proofs.

Form-less changed-origin refusal must honor the first production freshness guard. Demanding a later code would require bypassing protection; actual exact first-code and zero-effect assertions preserve security.

Password nodes are intentionally never exported or validly learned. Both-path genuine hostile-read rejection and exact native defensive guard evidence preserve read refusal without invalid-artifact construction. Actual failing text-control canary redaction remains required.
applicationConstraints: Apply exact three old/new deltas with matching source hashes; synchronize corresponding design oracle expectations and testing-strategy blanket so requirements do not contradict. Preserve all other accepted requirements and scenario counts.

For every form-less/navigation and password-read scenario, specify one source-bound expected first guard/code before executing. A generic error, missing target, failed setup or upstream authorization accident cannot earn acceptance.

Native parameter proofs must execute the real collector/executor in Chromium against the current final source, retain all logical variant assertions, and accompany genuine guided and published wiring evidence. Unit stubs cannot replace these.
C14 hasValue/controlValue learn and replay remain explicit logical checks; valid-text-to-password refusal and zero value reads must be proved where genuinely reachable.
C5/C6, two-path scope/effect/audit/rotation/revocation, specified slow/lost-response controls, six LOGIN and required C11 process-crash positions remain joined obligations.
No changed production guards, schema loopholes, forged observation nodes/artifacts, erased red history or unavailable external proof.
mechanicalChecks: Each exact old clause matches canonical source once.
Collector pin-origin TARGET_CHANGED guard precedes form-action refusal.
Production recorded-element guard covers read and hasValue with exact PASSWORD_CONTROL_READ_REFUSED.
next: Coordinator may apply these documentation deltas and dispatch scoped implementation. Full independent QA must assess complete evidence before Done.
